palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward. Here's a 255-character palindrome for you:

```
Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow.
Vow, my judge! What vexes me?
Madam Arora teaches malayalam.
Lavalava.
```

Note: This is just an example. You can generate your own palindrome by selecting words and phrases and arranging them in a way that they read the same backward as forward.
